content.study: Debentures and debenture trustees. Debentures are regulated by s. 71: security, trustee, redemption reserve where applicable, and Tribunal remedy on default. The section applies only to the persons, companies, and transactions it names. A filing, approval, or penalty arises only where the section or a rule under it says so. It does not create a power that is reserved to another section or to the Tribunal. Not a verified closure.

sections.heading: Principle
sections.body: Debentures are regulated by s. 71: security, trustee, redemption reserve where applicable, and Tribunal remedy on default.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: A debenture acknowledges debt and may be convertible. Secured debentures require a charge registered under s. 77 and a trustee. Holders do not vote as members. Default in redemption or interest can be brought to the Tribunal. Nomination is under s. 72.

sections.heading: Ingredients
sections.body: s. 71 issue conditions; Charge registration; Trustee; Tribunal remedy
